card.name: Start of a word split into pieces
card.fires_on: A short opening piece of a longer word that has been split, such as hy, HY, Th or a broken accented letter, right before the rest of the word. The word is often a medical term or a name.

modes.label: Medical word openings
modes.description: The first piece of a long medical term such as hyponatremia, hydrochloride or thiamine.
modes.example: WARNING: SERIOUS AND LIFE-THREATENING RISKS FROM USE OF TRAMADOL<< HY>>DROCHLORIDE AND AC

modes.label: Broken accented letters in names
modes.description: Half of an accented character in a foreign name, with the rest of the name to follow.

card.writes: It slightly pushes up pieces that begin with 'em' and pushes down unrelated odd pieces, so the output effect is weak.
card.plain: It fires on the first piece of a long word that the model reads in parts, such as hyponatremia or thiamine.
